metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Digangali, Chad increase in October 23, 2022 compared to September 18, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Need surface-water extent → use JRC Global Surface Water “seasonality” band (value = 12 means water was present in every month of the reference years 1984-2020). - However, the question asks about single-date (daily) water presence, so instead use Sentinel-1 SAR (C-band) which penetrates clouds and gives reliable open-surface-water mapping in semi-arid Chad. - Dates: 2021-09-18 (baseline) and 2022-10-23 (comparison). - Location: Digangali village, eastern Chad → ~14.6°N 22.3°E. Create a small 2-km radius buffer around a point inside the village footprint to capture any reservoirs/ponds. 2. Masking strategy. - Sentinel-1 has no clouds; instead apply: 1. IW mode only (common), 2. Same pass direction (to avoid back-scatter differences), 3. HH polarization for water detection. - Create simple water mask: σ°HH < –18 dB is empirically open water in this region. - Count pixels inside geometry for both dates. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error. - Check collection size for each date; if zero images → C1. - After masking, count valid pixels; if 0 → C2. - Compute water area (ha) for each date; if None/NaN → C3. - Compare areas: if Oct-2022 > Sep-2021 → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time pt = ee.Geometry.Point([22.30, 14.60]) # Digangali, Chad roi = pt.buffer(2000) # 2-km radius date1 = '2021-09-18' date2 = '2022-10-23' # 2. Sentinel-1 acquisition def get_s1_water(date): coll = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(ee.Date(date).advance(-3,'day'), ee.Date(date).advance(3,'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'ASCENDING')) .select(['HH'])) if coll.size().getInfo() == 0: return None img = coll.first() water = img.lt(-18) # σ°HH < -18 dB → water waterArea = (water.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9) .get('HH')) # values in m² return waterArea.getInfo() # 3. Compute extents area1 = get_s1_water(date1) area2 = get_s1_water(date2) # Validation if area1 is None or area2 is None: print("Images: 0 for at least one date") print("C1") elif area1 == 0 and area2 == 0: print("No water pixels in either date") print("C2") elif area1 is None or area2 is None or ee.Number(area1).getInfo() is None or ee.Number(area2).getInfo() is None: print("Calculation produced None/NaN") print("C3") else: ha1, ha2 = area1/1e4, area2/1e4 print(f"2021-09-18 water: {ha1:.1f} ha") print(f"2022-10-23 water: {ha2:.1f} ha") print("A" if ha2 > ha1 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([22.30, 14.60])   # Digangali, Chad
roi = pt.buffer(2000)                     # 2-km radius

date1 = '2021-09-18'
date2 = '2022-10-23'

# 2. Sentinel-1 acquisition
def get_s1_water(date):
    coll = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
              .filterBounds(roi)
              .filterDate(ee.Date(date).advance(-3,'day'), ee.Date(date).advance(3,'day'))
              .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
              .filter(ee.Filter.eq('orbitProperties_pass', 'ASCENDING'))
              .select(['HH']))
    if coll.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    img = coll.first()
    water = img.lt(-18)                       # σ°HH < -18 dB → water
    waterArea = (water.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
                     .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                                   geometry=roi,
                                   scale=100,
                                   maxPixels=1e9)
                     .get('HH'))             # values in m²
    return waterArea.getInfo()

# 3. Compute extents
area1 = get_s1_water(date1)
area2 = get_s1_water(date2)

# Validation
if area1 is None or area2 is None:
    print("Images: 0 for at least one date")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif area1 == 0 and area2 == 0:
    print("No water pixels in either date")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif area1 is None or area2 is None or ee.Number(area1).getInfo() is None or ee.Number(area2).getInfo() is None:
    print("Calculation produced None/NaN")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    ha1, ha2 = area1/1e4, area2/1e4
    print(f"2021-09-18 water: {ha1:.1f} ha")
    print(f"2022-10-23 water: {ha2:.1f} ha")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if ha2 > ha1 else "<answer>B</answer>")
